# Exit-code register

> The exit codes a consumer can script against for `init`, `sync`, `doctor` and
> `uninstall`. The set of codes is scanned from the code that returns them and
> reconciled against the meanings on every regeneration, so a code listed here
> is one the command returns today. Regenerate with
> `./scripts-run src/scripts/build_exit_code_register`; the drift check is
> `tests/scripts/build_exit_code_register.test.ts`.

## `init`

| Code | Meaning | Emitted in |
|---|---|---|
| `0` | installed, and every written file is current | `src/scripts/install`, `src/scripts/install.ts` |
| `1` | the install failed or was refused partway (missing payload, payload sync failed, a write failed, `--scope=project` without dev mode) | `src/scripts/install`, `src/scripts/install.ts` |
| `2` | usage error, or a refusal before anything is written (own source checkout, unsupported schema version, rule-layer overlap, no TS runner) | `src/scripts/install`, `src/scripts/install.ts` |
| `3` | installed what it could, but preserved at least one user-modified file — the install is stale until the `.agent-config.new` sidecars are resolved | `src/install/conflictTracker.ts` |

## `sync`

| Code | Meaning | Emitted in |
|---|---|---|
| `0` | every tool in the lockfile is present, or was replayed | `src/scripts/_cli/cmd_sync.ts` |
| `1` | no install lockfile to replay, or a replay the installer failed (its `1`, forwarded) | `src/scripts/_cli/cmd_sync.ts` |
| `2` | usage error, or a replay the installer refused (its `2`, forwarded) | `src/scripts/_cli/cmd_sync.ts` |
| `3` | replayed, but the installer preserved a user-modified file (its `3`, forwarded) — stale until resolved | via init |

## `doctor`

| Code | Meaning | Emitted in |
|---|---|---|
| `0` | no manifest drift; under `--ci`, `--check` or `--strict`, also no check at the tripping status | `src/scripts/_cli/cmd_doctor.ts`, `src/scripts/_cli/_doctor_strict.ts` |
| `1` | manifest drift; or, under `--ci`, `--check` or `--strict`, a check at the tripping status | `src/scripts/_cli/cmd_doctor.ts`, `src/scripts/_cli/_doctor_strict.ts` |
| `2` | usage error, unresolvable project root, failed repair, no install in the tree, or `--check` on a check that was skipped | `src/scripts/_cli/cmd_doctor.ts` |

## `uninstall`

| Code | Meaning | Emitted in |
|---|---|---|
| `0` | removed what it owned, or there was nothing to remove | `src/scripts/_cli/cmd_uninstall.ts` |
| `1` | no lockfile and no `--force`, or a removal was refused | `src/scripts/_cli/cmd_uninstall.ts` |
| `2` | usage error | `src/scripts/_cli/cmd_uninstall.ts` |
